g1.label: 1 — work in a real ___
g1.why: Students do their placement in a real business — a company.

g2.label: 2 — a normal working ___
g2.why: "A working day" is the set phrase for the hours you spend at work.

g3.label: 3 — a small animal ___
g3.why: An animal clinic is where a vet treats animals — that is where Lena worked.

g4.label: 4 — she was very ___
g4.why: She had never worked with a vet before, so she felt nervous.

g5.label: 5 — her first ___ were simple
g5.why: Tasks are the jobs you are given: cleaning, fetching water, answering the phone.

g6.label: 6 — the vet let her ___ an operation
g6.why: After "let somebody" you use the bare infinitive, and she was allowed to watch.

g7.label: 7 — never been so ___
g7.why: The sentence contrasts "tired" with a positive feeling about her own work: proud.

g8.label: 8 — helps young people to choose a ___
g8.why: A career is the working life you choose; a corner or a carpet has nothing to do with jobs.

g1.label: 1 — Lena ___ her placement last Friday
g1.why: "Last Friday" is a finished time in the past, so use the simple past.

g2.label: 2 — three applications so far
g2.why: "So far" means up to now, so the present perfect is needed.

g3.label: 3 — in a garage since 2023
g3.why: "Since 2023" means it started in the past and still continues: present perfect.

g4.label: 4 — our work experience in May
g4.why: "In May" names a finished point in the past, so use the simple past.

g5.label: 5 — I have never ___ in an office
g5.why: After "have never" you need the past participle: worked.

g6.label: 6 — ___ you ever visited a factory?
g6.why: Questions about life experience with "ever" use the present perfect.

g7.label: 7 — When ___ you start?
g7.why: "When...?" asks about a finished moment, so use did + infinitive.

g8.label: 8 — Anna ___ already finished
g8.why: "Already" + past participle needs the present perfect, third person singular: has.

g1.label: 1 — you have to write an ___
g1.why: You write an application when you apply for a job; an appointment is a meeting time.

g2.label: 2 — the document listing school and skills
g2.why: A CV (curriculum vitae) lists your school, your skills and your experience.

g3.label: 3 — they invite you to an ___
g3.why: An interview is the meeting where the company asks you questions.

g4.label: 4 — employees get their ___
g4.why: The salary is the money employees are paid every month.

g5.label: 5 — her ___ showed her round
g5.why: A supervisor is the person at work who is responsible for you.

g6.label: 6 — always be ___
g6.why: Punctual means being on time — which is why you arrive five minutes early.

g7.label: 7 — a vet ___ sick animals
g7.why: To treat an animal means to give it medical care.

g8.label: 8 — students start an ___
g8.why: An apprenticeship (Ausbildung) combines working in a company with vocational school.
